title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 5, section 11 (Bowen Island)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 5 No Shooting Areas (Section 6)
Bowen Island
11 That portion of the Province of British Columbia in Howe Sound, NWD, which is contained within the following described boundaries: All that portion of land, including the foreshore above the low water mark of Bowen Island, situate and lying at the entrance of Howe Sound, NWD.
